Preamble text that appears before the first heading.

# Manual Title

Body of the first section.

@note A tag with no comment prefix
  Manual pages accept tags at the start of a line.

## A Sub-Section

Text in the sub-section, linking to @{Doc} and to `Doc.read`.

```
# This hash inside a fence is not a heading.
```

### Third Level

Text at level three.

#### Fourth Level

A level-four heading creates no section reference.

## A Sub-Section

A second heading with the same text, so the symbol is suffixed.
